primary_question: Does adding newly reported negatives suppress false actions without degrading the existing deployment regression?
selection_split: ABCP and Qtrain only; Qholdout sealed until selection
ranking: Qtrain mean maximum named probability ascending
processed_replay_note: P/Q have burned-in labels removed and are not re-enhanced; raw-scene gate cannot be reconstructed. P differs from the earlier threshold sweep preprocessing. Fresh paired baseline only.
cache_interpolation_note: New training windows resize cropped delivery frames directly to 400x224; replay downsizes to 720 first to approximate native recognition resolution. Neither can recover pre-SR/denoise/encoding pixels.
inference_limit: Overlapping windows are correlated; 2 heldout sessions, 9 videos, one training seed; no population-level significance or real-time throughput claim.
coverage_note: The on-site training cache and A/B/C/P regression do not contain positive examples of the five uncovered classes; no nine-action retention claim is possible.
fallback_if_no_epoch_passes: Before opening holdout, evaluate original/candidate weight interpolation at new-weight fractions 0.25, 0.5, 0.75; apply the same regression gates. If no improvement passes, preserve deployed model and deliver candidates/report without claiming a production upgrade.
